Red Loam: Add organic compost (FYM/vermicompost) to improve water retention and fertility.
Black Cotton Soil (Vertisol): Ensure proper drainage channels; vertisols crack when dry and swell when wet.
Avoid deep tillage during wet season to prevent compaction.
Alluvial Soil: Maintain balanced NPK fertilization; alluvial soils respond well to inputs.
Sandy Soil: Apply mulch to reduce evaporation; sandy soils have poor water retention.
Use drip irrigation for efficient water delivery.
Clayey Delta Soil: Avoid waterlogging; use raised bed cultivation during monsoon.
Apply gypsum if sodicity is a concern.
Lateritic Soil: Apply lime to correct soil acidity; laterites are often acidic.
Supplement phosphorus, as laterites fix it heavily.
